summary: The core 3-lane runner loop and jump tutorial worked well, taking the player to 246m with 21 coins. However, late-registering swipes caused frustrating crashes, and both the revive popup and game-over transition suffered from low-contrast UI and dead-air delays.

items.title: Swipes fail to register before crashing into tall blocks
items.evidence: At t=11.1s and t=20.2s, the player saw tall pink X blocks ahead and attempted to swipe away, but crashed before the input registered (no_effect).
items.suggestion: Increase swipe input responsiveness and add input buffering during lane transitions, or slightly increase the spacing before tall pink X blocks at higher speeds.

items.title: Faint Game Over screen with no buttons before end card
items.evidence: At t=20.2s, the screen showed faint, low-contrast 'GAME OVER' text with SPD 0 and no actionable buttons, leaving a 2-second dead-air gap until the end card appeared at t=22.2s.
items.suggestion: Make the 'GAME OVER' text high-contrast immediately on crash and transition directly to the end card or display a 'PLAY NOW' button right away.

items.title: Low-contrast Revive button on crash popup
items.evidence: On the 'CRASHED! Keep your run going?' popup at t=11.1s, the central 'REVIVE' button is dark and blends into the road, while 'No thanks' is bright white and underlined.
items.suggestion: Style the 'REVIVE (1 FREE)' button with a bright neon fill and glowing border so it clearly stands out as the primary action over 'No thanks'.

items.title: Slight delay to first successful lane switch
items.evidence: It took 2.0s from the first playable frame for the player's first swipe to visibly register during the 'Swipe to switch lanes!' tutorial.
items.suggestion: Trigger the lane-switch tutorial prompt immediately at 0.0s with a slightly slower initial car speed so first-time players can complete their first dodge within 1 second.
